sections.content: filter applies GPU effects: blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale, hue-rotate, drop-shadow. mix-blend-mode blends element colors with backdrop (multiply, screen, overlay).
Backdrop-filter blurs whatever is BEHIND an element — the frosted-glass effect used by modern navbars.
Key points: filter on body is expensive, backdrop-filter needs a translucent background to show, and blend modes can surprise — test on real content.
